Just kidding 😜
I caught COVID over the weekend and I’m taking the week off.
Image from What COVID taught me about product management
Image from What COVID taught me about product management
So far it’s been fairly mild, but I’m forcing myself to take it easy.
**In the meantime:**

2. Don’t miss my latest [podcast interview with Gibson Biddle](https://link.chtbl.com/LennysPodcastGibsonBiddle) . We cover:
✔️ 5 real-life Netflix strategy case studies
✔️ The DHM product strategy framework
✔️ Roadmap prioritization using GEM
✔️ Why build a personal board of directors
✔️ What it takes to become a CPO someday

Image from What COVID taught me about product management
[Listen to Gibson Biddle](https://link.chtbl.com/LennysPodcastGibsonBiddle)
See you next week!

. Applications close in about a week.
[**Apply here**](https://program.reforge.com/apply)
